subject: Future Tech
title: Printed Pills and Drug Delivery
description: A short lesson to help you apply Printed Pills and Drug Delivery.

hook.text: In 2015, the FDA approved Spritam, the first 3D-printed pill.

buildup.text: 3D printing lets pharmacists customize dose strength, release timing, and combine multiple drugs into a single pill.

discovery.text: A polypill printed with layers of different drugs could replace five heart medications in one daily tablet.

twist.text: Each patient metabolizes drugs differently. Printed pills could be tailored to an individual's genetics and body weight.

climax.text: Hospital pharmacies may one day print custom pills on demand, ending the one-size-fits-all era of mass-produced drugs.

punchline.text: Your next prescription might come from a printer.
